'''Tikowl''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Hootlet]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Chronerva]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Tikowl loves answering all kinds of questions, including 'Why do humans hunt and return empty-handed?' and 'Who should settle Tatari disputes, trainers or Tatari?' Er, beats me anyhow."

Tikowl is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A green, owl-like creature with large, yellow eyes, an off-white underbelly, and a golden pendulum for a tail. It also has yellow accents in its wings, and four legs like a mythological griffin.

Tikowl's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces its green feathers with pink.

== Evolution Trial ==
Tikowl's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Chronerva]] you need to complete the following two tasks:
* Feed Tikowl to increase stats 3 times.
* Shoot 20,000 pinballs.

== Trivia ==
* Tikowl and its evolutions were added to the game on 5/12/2026 alongside [[Pandagrand]] and [[Sealord]].
